description: No prerequisites. Returns paginated scenarios cards with scenarioId (alias of id), name, summary and available provider/category/difficulty. Pass scenarioId to scenario.get. Filters precede stable ID paging: limit default 8, maximum 20; pass nextCursor as cursor until null. detailed=true restores rich cards. Next tool is scenario.get, then simulation.create with scenarioId. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/scenario.list
name: scenario.list
title: List Scenarios
